## Hypothesis

The keeper's combo modifies exit parameters (tighter stop at -35% premium, 15-minute time stop, Chandelier arm at 50%) to improve edge capture by reducing losses on J loser days while preserving gains on J winner days. The hypothesis is that these exits prevent whipsaw losses during volatile periods and lock in profits faster on strong moves.

## Mechanism

Entry logic remains baseline (volatility ratio threshold=1.0, strike offset=2). Exit triggers: 
- Premium stop at -35% of entry premium (catastrophe cap)
- Time stop at 15 minutes after entry
- Chandelier profit-lock arms at +50% premium (volatility-adjusted trailing stop)
- Standard TP1 at +50% premium (sell 2/3) and runner exit rules apply
